title: Effect of an Instruction
statement: For a word width $W$, an instruction acts on a memory state $m$ by updating the destination register for a constant assignment, arithmetic operation, or load, or the addressed memory cell for a store. A constant assignment writes the $W$-bit word representing $1$; arithmetic uses word arithmetic, and loads and stores use the integer represented by the relevant word as the memory address. All other instructions leave the memory state unchanged.
